definitions.explanation: A function or position that someone or something has in a particular situation or activity.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}としての{役割|やくわり}は{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The role of a parent is significant.

examples.japanese: それぞれの{役割|やくわり}を{決|き}めましょう。
{彼|かれ}はチームで{重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: He plays an important role in the team.
examples.notes: 役割を果たす = to fulfill a role

notes:
{役割|やくわり} refers to an assigned role, function, or part that someone or something plays. Used broadly in professional, social, and personal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill a role
- {役割|やくわり}を{担|にな}う: to take on a role
- {役割|やくわり}を{演|えん}じる: to play a role (theatrical/figurative)
- {役割|やくわり}{分担|ぶんたん}: division of roles
- {重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}: an important role

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {役割|やくわり}: role, function (assigned part)
- {役目|やくめ}: duty, task (emphasis on responsibility)
- {役|やく}: role (shorter, often in theater or games)
- {機能|きのう}: function (more technical/mechanical)

WORD FORMATION:
{役|やく} (role) + {割|わり} (allotment). Literally "allotted role."
